name: JMISJUSTME Freestanding Website + Android APK Foundation

authority.source_rule: One shared JM source body; website and APK are delivery forms, not competing rebuilds.

support_rails.github: source corridor, mirror and recovery rail only

requirements: same registries and route truth used by the APK

android.release_definition: A signed installable APK/AAB with its own application identity; not merely Add to Home Screen.
android.architecture: shared web core plus owner-controlled native Android shell
android.offline_rule: The shell must retain a usable local core and must not become useless when a delivery host is unavailable.

governance: Website first; APK always in view.
GitHub and Cloudflare may support delivery but do not own the public identity.
Do not fork the Estate into unrelated web and Android bodies.
Use JM coding bodies as source authority; standard web and Android code are delivery targets.
